rule: Every direct command must be bound to the registered live Google Drive project manifest before execution. Source-set versions are read live and are not pinned here. A project with unresolved source-integrity drift is non-executable even when the runtime itself is healthy.

bindings.blocking_reason: Live raw Drive audit on 2026-08-15 found PROJECT-MANIFEST.md and SHA256SUMS.txt out of sync with source-registry.md, capability-registry.md and tool-plugin-registry.md. The runtime is validated, but new SEO direct commands must wait until the canonical Drive source set is reconciled and re-hashed.

bindings.formal_scan_reason: Project Leads 10.5.0 requires provenance-bound Leadscanner ingestion with webactueel-leadscanner-ingest/1.0 and artifact readback. Designchecker lead-formal does not yet implement that exact contract and therefore cannot be used as formal qualification evidence.
